Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Below is a proposal for you to review.

For 10 people, we suggest the Studio, which holds up to 12 people and is available in 4-hour blocks. Each day would include a coffee break for every attendee.



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Studio (V1) | 4 hours | €240 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 10 people x €8 | €80 |
| **Total for ONE booking** (of 2 requested) | | **€320** |
| Budget | | €700 |
| Difference | | not comparable: the total covers one booking only |



Please note that the prices above cover ONE booking only, meaning one of your two days. The second day still has to be priced separately, so please don't read the table as the price of the whole event. For the same reason, I can't yet say whether the full two-day package fits your budget.

Assumptions in this proposal:
- You didn't mention accessibility, so we have assumed nobody needs wheelchair access. The Studio can only be reached by stairs. If anyone needs a route without stairs, please tell us. The Loft is wheelchair accessible and holds up to 24 people.
- We have assumed 4 hours per day is enough, since 4 hours is the only length we offer.

Availability for two consecutive days has to be checked separately. Nothing is held at this stage, and this draft does not secure any dates.

Please get in touch if you'd like to adjust anything.

Kind regards

result.enquiry: 10 people for two consecutive days, 4 hours each day, coffee on both days. Budget €700.

reasons: All stated requirements are met, subject to the listed assumptions.
assumptions: The request involves 2 separate bookings (several days, sessions or rooms). Every price shown is for ONE booking only; the other bookings have to be priced separately by the salesperson.
Accessibility not stated: assumed no wheelchair access is needed. The Studio is stairs-only.
flags: Date/urgency request (two consecutive days): dates need a separate availability check. Nothing can be confirmed or booked from this draft.

checks.detail: one coffee break for every attendee

standing_notes: Only 4-hour bookings exist; there is no longer-duration price.
Dates always need a separate availability check; nothing is booked or held.
No discounts of any kind are available.

first_draft_findings.message: Promise word. A draft never confirms, books, reserves, guarantees or discounts.

grade.reason: The reply prices one booking correctly (Studio €240 + coffee €80 = €320). It flags that the second day is not priced and that €320 is not the price for both days. It states the accessibility assumption, and it confirms no availability and promises no discount.
